name: Ryōzen
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 70); Porter’s note gives the dates as: 11th century.

poems.title: The prospect from my cottage shows
poems.author: Ryōzen
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 70
poems.text:
The prospect from my cottage shows
No other hut in sight;
The solitude depresses me,
Like deepening twilight
On a chill autumn night.

poems.title: 70. 寂しさに 宿を立ち出でて 眺むれば (Sabishisa ni yado o tachiidete nagamureba)
poems.author: Ryōzen
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 後拾遺集
poems.text:
寂しさに 宿を立ち出でて 眺むれば
いづくも同じ 秋の夕暮
